messages:
Alex (AE): kicking off POC with AcmeCorp — need quick alignment on scope, success criteria, and any enterprise blockers (pricing / security / legal). Can SE + Engs weigh in?
Maria (SE): thanks — quick summary of customer intents: invoice extraction, policy Q&A, and conversational triage. suggested golden set: ~150-250 examples across intents, include edge cases + non-answers.
Sam (Solutions Eng): pricing question up front: do they want hosted API trial or dedicated pool? committed qps affects pricing. for a 6-week pilot we usually recommend hosted with a burst to dedicated if throughput >200 qps.
Alex (AE): they asked about discounts if we commit to 6 months after pilot. what's common?
Sam (Solutions Eng): typical commit tiers: 3mo / 6mo / 12mo with stepped discounts. for a 6-week PoC we can offer 15% onboarding credit if they sign 6mo within 30 days. can confirm with sales ops.
Jit (Infra Eng): technical note for eval harness: keep KV cache warm for chat flows. small harness snippet to reference: 
```
# harness config (example)
seed_set: s3://acme-poc/goldens.jsonl
batch_size: 24
quant_profile: q4_0
model_variant: rwd-1.3-q4
metrics: [exact_match, semantic_sim, latency_ms]
```
Maria (SE): scoring ideas: structured extraction -> exact match on normalized fields; classification intents -> semantic_sim > 0.85 (embedding cosine); latency -> p95 < 350ms for hosted; human spot-check 5% of outputs.
Alex (AE): ok can we make success criteria simple for the customer? propose: 1) intent classification F1 >= 0.88, 2) extraction exact match >= 92%, 3) no critical security flags, 4) p95 latency < 350ms on hosted baseline.
Priya (Security): security blockers: they require SOC2 + DPA, KMS-backed keys (customer-managed preferred), VPC peering or private endpoint, and audit logs for all requests. also: no real PII in goldens unless we have a signed data processing addendum.
Maria (SE): add regression gates: nightly eval run against goldens; if any metric drops > 3% absolute vs baseline -> auto-fail and notify eng + se. for quality regressions we require human review and can rollback model version.
Jit (Infra Eng): rollout policy: canary 10% for 24h, monitor eval harness metrics + error budget. automatic fallback to previous model if regression gate triggered.
Alex (AE): timeline proposal: seed set upload by Wed EOD, harness infra ready by Fri morning, first baseline report by next Wed, stakeholder demo next Thu. objections?
Sam (Solutions Eng): need clarity on input volume for pricing math — Alex pls get expected daily requests and avg token lengths.
Alex (AE): will confirm volume today.
Priya (Security): quick checklist for legal/security: send them questionnaire 1) SOC2 report, 2) DPA template, 3) encryption at rest/in transit details, 4) data retention policy, 5) export control stance. I'll prep answers by EOD.
Maria (SE): prompt design note: include negative examples (hallucination triggers) in goldens so harness catches overconfident but wrong answers. also canonicalize expected outputs (lowercase, trimmed).
Alex (AE): perfect. can we get a short one-pager for the customer with success criteria + pricing ask? Sam/Maria to draft.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I can draft the pricing + commitment options. Maria will add the eval success criteria.
deploy-bot: Reminder: canary deploys require 2 approvers and a passing harness baseline. :robot_face:
Alex (AE): thanks folks — moving to action items: @Maria upload seed template, @Sam draft pricing, @Priya security answers, @Jit confirm harness infra. I'll sync with customer after we have the one-pager. :thumbsup:
